parameters.query: =WITH updated AS (UPDATE content_assets SET parse_status=CASE WHEN mime_type ILIKE '%text%' OR mime_type ILIKE '%document%' OR file_name ILIKE '%.md' OR file_name ILIKE '%.txt' THEN 'parsed_metadata_only' ELSE 'unsupported' END, extracted_text=COALESCE(extracted_text,NULLIF('{{$json.extracted_text || ""}}','')), extracted_metadata=extracted_metadata || jsonb_build_object('parser_mode','credential_ready_metadata_or_payload','summary',NULLIF('{{$json.summary || ""}}','')), updated_at=now() WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND (source_type IN ('document','drive_file','google_doc') OR mime_type ILIKE '%text%' OR mime_type ILIKE '%document%') RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'documents_parsed','Document assets parsed/summarised where supported',jsonb_build_object('updated_assets',(SELECT count(*) FROM updated),'mode','metadata_or_payload')) SELECT count(*) AS updated_assets FROM updated;
